text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Summer Training Camp finally begins today.
Setting our sights on our next goal, the Tenno Sho (Autumn),
our days of rigorous training begin...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~~, the air here is always so wonderful!
Just taking a deep breath makes my energy surge.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Whoops... Oh, those girls—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
S-So, you see! The other day, um,
I turned you down because I had to train,
but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hey... won't you come with me after all? To the festival.
...I really want to go with you, Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Then I'll definitely get fired up. So—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm done just driving myself into the ground.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu, what should I do?
Maybe I've already decided to go with someone else.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeeehhh!! Really!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
W-Who's there?! Kura-chan?
Nakayama-san? Golshi-san?!
Or could it be—?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha!!
Just kidding, Kita-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Let's go to the festival together.
...We'll rest properly, then train, and keep getting stronger and stronger."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: By the end of the autumn season—you'll see, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! The promised Arima Kinen!
I have to train a ton for that...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Time for a breather!!
Let's wear our yukatas and go, Dia-chan!!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...And well, that's about it for
the meal menu during training camp.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
Your advice was very helpful.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You probably already know this, but
when it comes to injuries, rest and nutrition are everything.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: There may be times when you can't finish everything due to your physical condition, but... come consult me again if that happens. I'll propose an alternative menu to cover for it.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: For everything, from start to finish... Truly. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It's fine. Don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...It must be frustrating, but bear with it for now. Everyone is waiting for your return, after all.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Without fail, I'll return... to the turf.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
...Everyone has such wonderful looks on their faces.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as I nod...
I catch myself staring at the girl in front of me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, every single one of them has a motivated,
splendid look on their face, but—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hm? What is it?
choice_data_list: You're making the best face of all
You have the best look on your face.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Oh my.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Of course!
